name: Midou Subaru
source:
"How mysterious... I was a little interested when I first met you, but now I really feel like I want to know you a little."

The elegant knight of Saturn
The Saturn Prince.

The prince of Saturn who gives off an air of mystery. 
Due to the neutral way he always acts, its hard to tell when he’s really thinking.
He has a wide outlook and is always looking around him and casually considering everything.
He has an extremely unbalanced diet, and will absolutely not eat animal protein.
